scientific_integrity: Prior Poisson ABP renewal equations, renewal counting theory and a related finite-third-moment renewal swimmer result are credited and excluded from the new claim.
scientific_limitations: Exact results are for independent Lomax renewal intervals with exponent strictly between one and two, angle-only resets, finite positive rotational diffusivity and propulsion. No stationarity of unconfined position or Gaussian limit is claimed. Theorems are based on a mathematical proof plus reproducible finite diagnostics, not an independent scientific audit.
title: Preparation-dependent superdiffusion in a heavy-tailed orientationally reset swimmer
